recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的 CD13 對 CD33 流式圖：幾乎全部原始細胞 CD33 陽性（約 10³–10⁴·⁷），CD13 則多為陰性到弱陽性，只有部分延伸到 10⁴–10⁵，屬骨髓系相關抗原表現，但 CD13/CD33 本身不足以判定骨髓系別。
features: Gated on blasts; CD13-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single broad blast population with CD33 expression spanning about 10^3 to 5x10^4
CD13 negative to dim on most blasts with a partial tail of positive events up to about 10^5
Small fraction of blasts with dim CD33 below 10^3
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays CD13 versus CD33. The blasts show predominantly positive CD33 expression over a broad intensity range, with CD13 negative to dim and a partial tail of brighter CD13 expression. CD13 and CD33 are myeloid-associated antigens that are frequently expressed aberrantly in B-lymphoblastic leukemia and therefore do not establish myeloid lineage; myeloid assignment in MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation. In context, the findings are in keeping with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: CD13/CD33 co-expression is common in B-ALL (e.g., BCR::ABL1, ETV6::RUNX1) and is distinguished from MPAL by absence of MPO and monocytic differentiation.
CD33/CD13-positive blasts with MPO positivity but no B-lineage commitment markers (strong CD19 with CD79a/cCD22/CD10).
May express CD13/CD33 but shows cytoplasmic CD3 with CD7 and lacks CD19/CD79a.
